easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands.
description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Pili-Pala by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating at least two Treasures.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {R}
Repeat from step 2.
